note: How a Forged Technique plays in combat (PHB ch. 18; owner 2026-09-27: 'we should allow composite techniques to be created and added'). The technique carries its Primary Sphere Effect -- the typed effect of a talent the character knows, with that talent's own dice and save -- in its Base Form; each Secondary Sphere Effect adds its conditions, and its damage types become choices of the technique's damage. The PHB leaves these numbers to the GM; they are the owner's to change. Hostile conditions an Augment adds always allow a save against the Cultivation Save DC (save_for picks the ability).

strike.text: Make a weapon attack. On a hit, the Primary Sphere Effect.

projection.text: A ranged technique attack; on a hit, the Primary Sphere Effect.

burst.text: Enemies in a 15-foot radius make a saving throw.

cone.text: Enemies in a 15-foot cone make a saving throw.

line.text: Enemies in a 30-foot line make a saving throw.

ward.text: You or an ally within 30 feet gains temporary hit points and Resistance to the technique's damage types until the start of your next turn.

aura.text: A 10-foot aura around you for 1 minute (Concentration). It moves with you. A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a saving throw.

zone.text: A 20-foot-radius zone for 1 minute (Concentration). A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a saving throw.

movement.text: Move up to 30 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; the Primary Sphere Effect is the GM's to place along the way.

counter.text: Reaction; the GM resolves the trigger.

forced_movement.text: push 10 feet on a failed Strength save

minor_hindrance.text: a minor hindrance until the start of your next turn

lingering_effect.text: the effect lingers one more round (GM)

mobility_rider.text: you move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks

major_condition.text: a major condition, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns

severe_hindrance.text: a severe condition until the end of its next turn, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns

persistent_zone.text: The area remains for 1 minute (Concentration). A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes the saving throw again.

self_damage.text: you take Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus
